# CodeLovers — Full-Stack Software & SaaS Engineering Studio

CodeLovers is a Rabat-based product engineering studio delivering full-stack development, SaaS platforms, IoT systems, and e-commerce solutions for ambitious teams across MENA and Europe.

## Core Services

We build enterprise-grade web and mobile applications with modern frameworks: TanStack for app products, Next.js when SEO matters, React Native for mobile, Python/FastAPI for backend systems, and comprehensive DevOps infrastructure.

**Full-Stack Development** — React · TanStack · TypeScript · Node.js · Python  
[Learn more](https://wearecodelovers.com/services)

**SaaS Platform Engineering** — Multi-tenant architecture, authentication, payment integration, real-time features  
[Learn more](https://wearecodelovers.com/services)

**IoT & Real-Time Systems** — MQTT, TCP/IP protocols, device management, monitoring dashboards  
[Learn more](https://wearecodelovers.com/services)

**E-Commerce Solutions** — Headless commerce with Shopify Hydrogen, custom storefronts, payment integration  
[Learn more](https://wearecodelovers.com/services)

**DevOps & Infrastructure** — CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, cloud deployment  
[Learn more](https://wearecodelovers.com/services)

## Featured Projects

### Snookly — Snooker Club Operations Platform

Multi-tenant snooker club management system in production with RFID member cards, live table scoring, café/billiard POS, and administrative dashboard.

**Stack:** Next.js · Supabase · TypeScript  
[Read case study](https://wearecodelovers.com/case-studies/snookly/)

### Passion Fitness — Martial Arts Gym Platform

Multi-tenant martial arts gym platform serving BJJ gyms in Morocco. Features class booking, Mon Parcours belt progression tracking, RollMap member connections, web dashboard, and native mobile app.

**Stack:** Next.js · Supabase · Expo React Native · Paddle payments  
[Read case study](https://wearecodelovers.com/case-studies/passion-fitness/)

### AgroGina — Precision Agriculture Platform

Farm management and agronomy platform with satellite imagery analysis for crop monitoring, NDVI vegetation indices via Google Earth Engine, and multi-tenant geospatial analytics.

**Stack:** React · TanStack · shadcn/ui · NestJS on Bun · FastAPI · Supabase · PostgreSQL RLS  
**Live:** [agrogina.com](https://agrogina.com/)  
[Read case study](https://wearecodelovers.com/case-studies/agrogina)

### LoginTel SaaS — IoT Cold Chain Monitoring

Comprehensive cold chain monitoring platform with real-time IoT tracking, alerting systems, and compliance reporting for temperature-sensitive logistics.

**Stack:** Next.js · Strapi CMS · Python FastAPI · TCP device parsing · Prometheus · Grafana  
[Read case study](https://wearecodelovers.com/case-studies/logintel-saas)

### WhatsApp Reservation Bot — Multi-Tenant Automation

Multi-tenant WhatsApp Business API integration enabling businesses to automate bookings with webhook integrations and real-time WebSocket updates.

**Stack:** React · Express.js · Drizzle ORM · N8N workflow automation  
[Read case study](https://wearecodelovers.com/case-studies/whatsapp-reservation-bot)

## Technical Expertise

7+ years of hands-on experience with React, TanStack, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, and cloud infrastructure. Built systems for 4D Logiciel, SWIBECO, and SQLI serving thousands of users.

Established CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, and production monitoring across all platforms. Specialized in IoT, real-time systems, e-commerce, and SaaS with modern tech stacks.
